name: New York NYSPHSAA State Cross Country Championships
headline: New York NYSPHSAA State Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 26 East Aurora won the Class C boys title with 33 points, 39 ahead of Marcus Whitman, whose Desmond Hill won the race in 15:28.9; Horace Greeley’s Ryan Sykes ran the day’s fastest time, 14:57.6, to win Class B, and Corning’s Christopher Lawson won Class A in 15:07.5. Brighton (A, 75), Burnt Hills-Ballston Lake (B, 63) and Beaver River (D, 64) won the other boys team titles. Nottingham’s Delilah Pandori-Howell won girls Class A in 17:26.0 as Northport took the team title (53), with Ithaca’s Tsadia Bercuvitz third and Shenendehowa’s Riley Lynch seventh, and Sayville (B), Cold Spring Harbor (C) and South Lewis (D) won the other girls titles.
